title: A leap year checker
description:
Decide whether years are leap years.

```
Year? 1900
1900 is not a leap year
Year? 2024
2024 is a leap year (February has 29 days)
Year? 0
```

starter.main.lua:
local function is_leap(year)
  return false
end

while true do
  io.write("Year? ")
  local year = tonumber(io.read())
  if not year or year == 0 then break end
  -- TODO
end

hints: `year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0)`: Lua's "not equal" is `~=` (lesson 1.05).
`cond and "a" or "b"` picks between two values, as long as `"a"` is not `false` or `nil`.
requirements: A leap year divides by 4, except years that divide by 100, unless they also divide by 400.
Write it as a function `is_leap(year)` with `and`, `or` and `not`.
Keep asking until the year is 0.
stretch: Count the leap years between two years.
